### Total

#### `weight_of`

Total: it answers every input in the ranges it declares. Its head writes no effect: this is what kaname infers.

```kn
fn weight_of(lines: list[Line] count >=1 <=30) -> mass[oz]
  sum(lines, l => l.weight × l.qty)
```

#### `quote`

Total: it answers every input in the ranges it declares. Its head writes `total`, and kaname holds it to that.

None when the cart is not a Media Mail parcel, or is heavier than the part of the price list the rule holds.

```kn
fn quote(lines: list[Line] count >=1 <=30) -> money[USDc]? total
  description "None when the cart is not a Media Mail parcel, or is heavier than the part of the price list the rule holds"
  let weight = weight_of(lines: lines)
  if weight <= 15lb
    media_mail(weight: weight, media_only: all(lines, l => l.media)).price
  else
    none
```
